entities.name: Fernando Alonso
entities.description: Alonso signed a contract extension with Renault for 2006 in April 2005. He won six of the first nine races and finished no lower than second to lead the championship with 84 out of a possible 90 points. He won the championship by finishing second at the Brazilian Grand Prix.
